summary: Phase 4 RE-TEST after fixes: (1) PDF endpoint fix verified — GET /api/tickets/{id}/pdf?token=<jwt> now returns 200 application/pdf with 1975 bytes, valid %PDF-1.3 header, no more bytearray AttributeError. (2) Affiliate Dashboard i18n verified for all 5 languages (DE/EN/FR/IT/ES). Test method: bypassed login form via fetch+localStorage('tc_token'); switched language via localStorage('tc_lang', <code>) — note: real key is `tc_lang`, not `lang`. Home slogan correctly switches: DE='51.000+ BAHNHÖFE · 34 LÄNDER · EIN TICKET. GANZ EUROPA.', EN='51,000+ STATIONS · 34 COUNTRIES · ONE TICKET. ALL OF EUROPE.', IT='51.000+ STAZIONI · 34 PAESI · UN BIGLIETTO. TUTTA L'EUROPA.'. /affiliate page in EN shows AFFILIATE DASHBOARD, TOTAL CLICKS, LAST 7 DAYS, CONVERSION FUNNEL, SEARCHES, CART ADDS, OUTBOUND CLICKS, PAID CHECKOUTS, SEARCH → CLICK RATE, CLICK → PAID RATE, MISSED OPPORTUNITIES (SEARCHED, NEVER CLICKED). /affiliate in IT shows DASHBOARD AFFILIATO, CLICK TOTALI, ULTIMI 7 GIORNI, FUNNEL DI CONVERSIONE, RICERCHE, AGGIUNTE CARRELLO, CLICK IN USCITA, PAGATI, TASSO RICERCA → CLICK, OPPORTUNITÀ PERSE. Funnel rate clamp working: page shows 100% / 0% — no rate >100% even though backend currently reports search_to_click_rate near 100 (28 searches / 28 outbound_clicks). data-testid='funnel' is preserved in all 5 languages. Backend regression: ALL 47/47 pytest tests pass (was 46/47). Endpoints curl-verified end-to-end: PDF→1975B/%PDF-1.3, ICS→3906B/text/calendar with VCALENDAR+VEVENT+VALARM(TRIGGER:-PT30M), PKPASS→1491B/application/vnd.apple.pkpass with pass.json/icon.png/icon@2x.png/manifest.json/signature. Provider deep-link tracking via /api/affiliate/click still works (regression test passes). No new bugs found. Iteration 4 HIGH bug fully resolved, design issue fully resolved.

minor.issue: funnel.search_to_click_rate can still theoretically exceed 100% on backend (carry-over: outbound_clicks counter includes pre-funnel-tracking history). UI now correctly clamps via Math.min(100, ...), so end-user impact is gone — but the underlying DB number remains uncapped. Optional: also clamp server-side for API consumers.

action_items: No fixes required for this iteration — both reported bugs are resolved. Optional cleanup carry-overs from iter 4 (not blocking): split server.py (1445 lines) into routers/services; split frontend/src/pages.jsx (~685 lines) into per-page component files; add admin-role gate on /api/stations/import; add MongoDB index + TTL on db.searches and db.cart_events.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1141-1145 now correctly handles bytearray from fpdf2 — `bytes(out) if isinstance(out, (bytes, bytearray)) else out.encode('latin-1')` covers both fpdf2 ≥2.7 (bytearray) and older fpdf (str). Verified live.

frontend/src/pages.jsx:552 uses `Math.min(100, data.funnel.search_to_click_rate)` — good defensive clamp. Consider also clamping click_to_paid_rate (line 556) symmetrically in case backend ratios drift > 100.

frontend/src/i18n.jsx has complete coverage for all `aff.*` keys across de/en/fr/it/es (lines 125-145). One missed key: `aff.providers` label says 'Active operators' (EN) but the German uses 'Aktive Anbieter' — consistent.
i18n localStorage key is `tc_lang` (not `lang`). Documenting for next testing agent because the obvious key name is wrong.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (PDF/ICS/PKPASS curl-verified, all 5 affiliate i18n locales verified, rate clamp verified, home slogan i18n verified, data-testid=funnel preserved)

context_for_next_testing_agent: PDF endpoint now stable across fpdf2 versions. i18n localStorage key is `tc_lang` and stores values 'de'|'en'|'fr'|'it'|'es'. Auth token key is `tc_token`. To quickly authenticate a Playwright session, POST /api/auth/login (key in response is `token`, not `access_token`) and set localStorage tc_token = <jwt>. To assert text on /affiliate, compare case-insensitively because the UI applies CSS text-transform: uppercase — innerText returns the rendered uppercase. The funnel section auto-renders for any logged-in user.
rca of the issue: Iteration 4 PDF bug was a one-line type-mismatch (fpdf2 ≥2.7 returns bytearray, but isinstance(...,bytes) was the only check). Fix at server.py:1142 widened the isinstance to (bytes, bytearray) and wraps with bytes(out). After fix, pytest test_pdf_with_query_token PASSES and curl returns 200 application/pdf 1975 bytes %PDF-1.3 header. i18n bug was missing aff.* keys in DE/EN/FR/IT/ES — i18n.jsx lines 125-145 now contain full coverage including aff.title, aff.total, aff.last7d, aff.funnel, aff.searches, aff.cart_adds, aff.outbound, aff.paid, aff.s2c_rate, aff.c2p_rate, aff.missed, aff.missed_unit, aff.top_providers/countries/routes, aff.recent, aff.no_clicks. pages.jsx now uses t('aff.*') throughout AffiliateDashboard.
